Our den

Made for the walk you take every day.

ONE DEN started with a simple idea. The person and the dog head out the same door, into the same weather, so why shouldn't they be dressed for it together?

We design out of Bowmanville, Ontario, where fall means larch going gold over the lake and winter means the leash comes out at seven whether it's sunny or snowing. Every piece is built for that walk. Washed fleece that softens with every wear. Quilting that holds up in the bush. Pockets placed by people who actually train dogs.

Two dogs circling one sun. That's the den. You and yours.
